title.en: RG 1 2023 ED FREE TRADE ZONES REGULATIONS

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

text.en: These Regulations may be cited as the Free Trade Zones Regulations.

The authority of a free trade zone shall —

(a) cause to be erected and maintained a perimeter fence or wall along the boundary of the zone with provision for suitable gates;

(b) cause the fence or wall and the gates to be illuminated during such hours as the Authority may consider necessary; and

(c) comply with any other directions given by the Minister to prevent unauthorised persons or goods from entering or leaving the zone.
The authority of a free trade zone shall provide facilities for the establishment of offices or examination stations of customs within the zone.

Building or structure shall not be erected within a free trade zone less than 6 metres from the perimeter of the zone, except with the prior written permission of the Controller of Customs and Excise.

heading.en: Dutiable goods not to be transferred

text.en:
(1) A person shall not transfer dutiable goods from one free trade zone to another except with the prior written permission of an officer of customs.

(2) A person wishing to obtain such written permission shall submit a declaration in such form and manner as may be prescribed by the Authority. 6 CAP. 255, Rg 1 Free Trade Zones

(3) In granting permission under this regulation, the officer of customs may impose such conditions as he thinks fit.

(1) A person permitted under section 9 by the Authority to assemble, mix or manipulate the goods within a free trade zone shall maintain full and proper records of the permitted operations containing such particulars as may be required by the Authority.

(2) Such records shall, on demand by a senior officer of customs, be produced for inspection. Directions

(1) A person shall not enter or leave a free trade zone except with the permission of the authority of that zone.

(2) The person granted the permission shall comply with such directions as may be given by the authority.
